<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!-- This Source Code Form is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public
   - License, v. 2.0. If a copy of the MPL was not distributed with this
   - file, You can obtain one at http://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/. -->
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html
  xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml"
  xmlns:xul="http://www.mozilla.org/keymaster/gatekeeper/there.is.only.xul"
  xmlns:html="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml"
  scrolling="false"
>
  <head>
    <title data-l10n-id="retention-dialog-title"></title>
    <meta
      http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy"
      content="default-src chrome:; script-src chrome: 'unsafe-inline' moz-src:; style-src chrome: 'unsafe-inline'"
    />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="chrome://messenger/skin/icons.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="chrome://messenger/skin/input-fields.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="chrome://messenger/skin/accountManage.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="chrome://messenger/skin/retention.css" />
    <link rel="localization" href="messenger/retention.ftl" />
    <script
      defer="defer"
      src="chrome://messenger/content/am-offline-retention.js"
    ></script>
  </head>
  <html:body
    xmlns="http://www.mozilla.org/keymaster/gatekeeper/there.is.only.xul"
  >
    <dialog buttons="accept,cancel" style="width: 100vw; height: 100vh">
      <vbox flex="1">
        <vbox align="start">
          <radiogroup id="retention-retain-by" class="indent">
            <radio
              id="retention-retain-all"
              data-l10n-id="retention-retain-all"
              value="1"
              oncommand="gRetentionDialog.onSelectionChanged()"
            />

            <hbox flex="1" align="center">
              <radio
                id="retention-retain-by-num-headers"
                data-l10n-id="retention-retain-by-num-headers"
                value="3"
                oncommand="gRetentionDialog.onSelectionChanged()"
              />
              <html:input
                id="retention-num-headers-to-keep"
                type="number"
                class="size4 input-inline"
                min="1"
                value="2000"
                aria-labelledby="retention-retain-by-num-headers retention-num-headers-to-keep retention-messages"
              />
              <label
                id="retention-messages"
                class="retention-unit-label"
                data-l10n-id="retention-messages"
                control="retention-num-headers-to-keep"
              />
            </hbox>

            <hbox flex="1" align="center">
              <radio
                id="retention-retain-by-age"
                data-l10n-id="retention-retain-by-age"
                value="2"
                oncommand="gRetentionDialog.onSelectionChanged()"
              />
              <html:input
                id="retention-days-to-keep-headers"
                type="number"
                class="size4 input-inline"
                min="1"
                value="30"
                aria-labelledby="retention-retain-by-age retention-days-to-keep-headers retention-days-old"
              />
              <label
                id="retention-days-old"
                class="retention-unit-label"
                data-l10n-id="retention-days-old"
                control="retention-days-to-keep-headers"
              />
            </hbox>
          </radiogroup>

          <hbox align="center" class="indent">
            <checkbox
              id="retention-always-keep-starred"
              data-l10n-id="retention-always-keep-starred"
            />
          </hbox>

          <description
            id="retention-removal-warning"
            data-l10n-id="retention-removal-warning"
            class="indent"
          />
        </vbox>
      </vbox>
    </dialog>
  </html:body>
</html>
